### [StAMPP](https://github.com/lpembleton/StAMPP/)

Statistical analysis of mixed ploidy populations. StAMPP calculates genetic distances, fixation indexes, and genomic relationship matrices from SNP genotype data across mixed and single ploidy populations.

[GitHub](https://github.com/lpembleton/StAMPP/) · [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=StAMPP)
</article>

<article class="package-item">
<img src="../assets/lpembleton/img/packages/corner.png" alt="corner hex sticker">

### [corner](https://github.com/lpembleton/corner)

A lightweight, console-width-aware toolkit for quickly inspecting the top-left corner of objects and recursively previewing lists without overwhelming your console.

[GitHub](https://github.com/lpembleton/corner)
</article>

<article class="package-item">
<img src="../assets/lpembleton/img/packages/resurface.png" alt="resurface hex sticker">

### [resurface](https://github.com/lpembleton/resurface)

Imputation of genotypic allele frequencies using the LD-kNNi algorithm.

[GitHub](https://github.com/lpembleton/resurface)
</article>
